name: 26452 · Weston, WV
findings: ZIP 26452 (Weston) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (70% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 26452 (Weston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
